title_zh: 缩小小麦气候项目的比较范围

scenario.label_zh: 限定小麦气候研究的资料比较范围
scenario.goal_zh: 区分长期变暖资料和单年产量，约定比较同一地区的多年记录并保留其他影响因素

context_zh: 两名学生讨论课堂农业研究选题，不报告现实气候新闻或提供种植建议。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: I'd like our agricultural project to ask how warming might affect wheat production.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: Then we need more than last year's harvest figure. One poor harvest doesn't establish a long-term pattern.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Could we compare the class dataset's temperature records with its harvest records for the same region?

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: Yes, over the full twenty years. We should also note the years with floods or changes in irrigation.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: So we shouldn't describe every decline as an adverse effect of higher temperatures.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: Exactly. Let's build the comparison first and list those other possible influences beside it.
